switched up sides like a larper that larps Oliver tree💔 .  #animalhospital #foryoupage #idk #shitpost #xybca  In Animal Hospital, you and up to three other players work at a hospital for animals. The main gameplay consists of checking in animals, scanning them for health conditions, and providing the correct Treatments while detecting and avoiding Anomalies. Classes Main article: Classes Classes are modifiers that can give the player specific starting stats, items or additional utility and function. You start the game with the free Intern class, as you play and earn Animal Coins, you can purchase more classes. Some available classes are the Nurse, Secretary, Surgeon, and Doctor. Upon being bought, classes will start at Level 1 and can be upgraded with exp earned by doing shifts, which will improve the buffs earned with the class. Each class comes with its own unique character, Skins, stats and abilities. There are 10 classes in the game. Some classes, like Secret Agent, cost Robux. Anomalies Main article: Anomalies Anomalies are creatures that roam the hospital which can attack and kill patients, visitors, and players. It’s your job to keep the hospital safe, the patients alive, and the anomalies to a minimum. You can fend off anomalies by using your taser (unlocked during Shift 4) and the gun, which can be brought from the store. You can use these items before an anomaly attacks or while it attacks. Sanity Main article: Sanity Sanity is one of the main Mechanics in Animal Hospital. Starting sanity can vary by class, and some classes affect how you can receive sanity both positively and negatively. The coffee and chocolate bar provide an increase to sanity. You can lose sanity by seeing a cursed photo, job stress, encountering Events, such as the ritual, or Enemies like the Stalker or Ghosts. Shifts Main article: Shifts Shifts are periods of time where you must deal with patients that enter the hospital. Shifts start by checking patients in, which then get treated according to their health conditions. At the end of the first four shifts, Dr. Harlow comes in and unlocks features for you, such as the shutter door and cameras, the taser, the emergency wing, a shop where you can buy various items at the start of each shift. Events are unlocked overtime such as fires, death rituals, and emergencies, where an influx of patients rush in, some in critical condition and some anomalies. When a patient is in critical condition, you only have a certain amount of time until they die. Examples of critical patients include: Those undergoing surgeries. Visitors that have fainted. Patients that are on fire. Patients that are being used for a death ritual. You may also encounter special patients like Ratthew and Ron from Accounting. Additionally, characters like Barney and Liz will show up in your shifts with special requests. These two characters are untreatable and do not ask you to check them in.
